ajustes.texto: Medals and the helper band show on your profile only if you turn them on. The wall of admissions is only for those who sign up.

tela.lead: Medals for what you did: finishing tracks, correcting essays, giving tutoring. Each one starts hidden and shows on your profile only if you turn it on. There is no scoreboard and no comparison between people.
tela.vazio: You have no medals yet. They come when you finish a track, correct essays in peer review or give tutoring.
tela.apagarTexto: It is gone for good, along with what you had already done towards it.

trilhas.lead: Mark the tracks you finished. The suggestions come from lessons completed on this device and do not leave it unless you tap.
trilhas.nenhuma: No lesson completed on this device yet.
trilhas.outraDica: The end of the track address, like historia-do-brasil

trilha.como: You mark it when you finish the track.

redacao.como: Each essay you correct and return in peer review counts.

monitoria.como: Each scheduled tutoring session you give counts.

faixa.lead: Instead of points, a written band. It counts the conversations where the person who asked marked your reply as the one that helped, or accepted it, in the last 12 months. Each conversation counts once, and your own question does not count.
faixa.regra: The rule, the same for everyone
faixa.desligada: Off: the band does not show on your profile.
faixa.ligada: On: the band shows on your profile, with no number.
faixa.ligar: Show the band on my profile
faixa.nenhumaAinda: You have no band yet: the first one starts at 3 conversations.

mural.lead: People who passed the ENEM or an entrance exam and wanted to share it. Only those who sign up are here, with their profile name or with a code name just for the wall, and they leave whenever they want.
mural.vazio: Nobody has signed up yet. Did you pass? Tell us here.
mural.sairTexto: Your entry is gone at once. You can sign up again later.

form.perfil: With my profile name, linking to it
form.codinome: With a code name just for the wall, no link
form.recadoDica: Up to 140 characters. No phone, email or ID.

mural.tirarMotivo: Reason (goes to the log and to the person)

aula.semTopico: This lesson has no topic yet. Whoever arrives first starts it; those who come later land in it.

erros.dado_pessoal: Remove phone, email or ID from the text.
erros.invalido:codinome: The code name needs 2 to 40 characters, with no insults.
erros.invalido:curso: The course needs 2 to 80 characters, with no insults.
erros.invalido:instituicao: The institution needs 2 to 80 characters, with no insults.
erros.invalido:recado: The message needs 2 to 140 characters, with no insults.
erros.invalido:trilha: That track address does not work: use only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
erros.invalido:muitas: You have already marked the maximum number of tracks (60).
erros.invalido:motivo: Write the reason, with 3 to 300 characters.
erros.confirme_codinome: Choose your Alumia code name first.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many changes in a row. Wait a little.
erros.generico: It did not work now. Try again.
